purpose: Recount existing75 records for narrow reported-label exploratory supervision, not run or authorize training, not promotion or independent confirmation
identity: Retain original peptide ID, exact case-sensitive sequence, chemistry annotation fingerprint, all covalent modifications and raw hash. Do not convert lowercase to uppercase for model encoding. Unknown salt/purity or termini does not prove a mixture; explicit unresolved disconnected mixtures/multicomponent labels cannot be treated as single-peptide labels.
labels: Existing raw MIC records for E.coli, recognized native units µg/ml or µM, positive parsed point/right/left bound and source linkage. Never convert units, pool native numeric units, infer net peptide content, replace censor bound with point, or reinterpret range/plusminus without source semantics.
core_descriptive_rows: E.coli MIC native units with point or one-sided bound, valid original source index and peptide sequence nonempty, excluding any recorded explicit disconnected/mixture/interchain or conflicting molecular identity signal. Unknowns remain typed, not assigned facts. Traceable but unresolved labels retained outside usable core.
source_missing_sensitivity: Show source-index unresolved rows separately; raw record traceability is not equivalent to verified paper measurement. No arbitrary source-index mapping.
plain_Witten_compatible: Core rows whose exact sequence uses uppercase20 canonical symbols and 1<=length<100; do not require known Free termini, material mass basis, or no modifications for a sequence-only predictor of as-reported endpoint. Preserve modification and missingness strata and explicitly limit estimand; cannot distinguish same sequence chemical forms.
strata_sensitivities: native µg/ml vs native µM separately
exact strain heuristic known vs unknown
one row per provenance signature count only, preserving all actual rows
group_counts: Report rows, unique peptide IDs, exact case sequences, annotation fingerprints, existing >=0.8 uppercase-backbone Levenshtein families and source-family union components. These are operational cluster counts, not certified independent peptides. Never sum strata with overlapping peptide/groups as independent N.
duplicates: Keep every activity and its raw comparator/label/provenance. Same peptide/protocol/source is not proof of duplicate nor independent replicate. Link potential identical-observation fingerprints; future grouped loss/weighting must avoid pseudoreplication and all same-entity/source/family records stay in one split.
isolation: All75 cached labels already exposed: developmental material only, not fresh blind evaluation. No train/dev/test reads. No relaxation of sealed test37 overlap/custody requirements; sample counts do not confer eligibility to use data in a protected AMP H5 pipeline.
decision_boundary: Scientific appropriateness of native-unit development can be YES even when causal standardized potency or mass-to-molar conversion is NOT identified. Actual execution remains unperformed and requires frozen development split/budget and existing test isolation constraints. Do not treat promotion-validator limits as a prohibition on exploratory counts.
attribution_pending_rationale: Saved note_reference says part of Dimer or Two-Peptide. Does not prove each MIC is mixture or isolated chain; narrow main task excludes pending attribution, retains all rows and reports sensitivity without exclusion.
